fire: Every Sunday afternoon we watched old episodes of Gilligan's Island together.
As a kid I loved the car chases in The Dukes of Hazzard.
The memo was signed by Averell Harriman before he left for London.
The treaty talks were led by Henry Kissinger in Paris.
In the stories, Sherlock Holmes finally confronts Professor Moriarty at the falls.
My favourite actor plays a corrupt treasurer in Boardwalk Empire.
The tag team known as The Hooligans won the belts last night.
The club hired Gerry Mulligan to play baritone saxophone.
quiet: Every Sunday afternoon we watched old films about a desert island together.
As a kid I loved the car chases in old police movies.
The memo was signed by the ambassador before he left for London.
The treaty talks were led by the foreign minister in Paris.
In the stories, Sherlock Holmes finally confronts his greatest enemy at the falls.
My favourite actor plays a corrupt treasurer in a gangster drama.
A group of rowdy hooligans was arrested outside the stadium last night.
Driving at night without lights is a serious hazard on rural roads.
